characters.name: The Witness
characters.title: Watcher of the Numerals
characters.description: A hooded figure standing motionlessly in the corner of the two-door antechamber, pointing toward the blood-red Roman numerals on the wall.

characters.name: The Distressed Father
characters.title: Echo of the Deceived
characters.description: A disheveled man clutching a crumpled dispatch notice. He pacing restlessly in the clinic lobby, desperately repeating that his booked ride never arrived.

addJournalChronicle.title: The Father's Dissolution
addJournalChronicle.text: The distressed father vanished into cold mist, still clutching the phantom dispatch notice.

characters.name: The Clinic Archivist
characters.title: Keeper of Case Records
characters.description: A seated bureaucratic silhouette whose spectacles reflect shifting fluorescent lights. It methodically files patient commitments into iron drawers.

characters.name: The Unmet Daughter
characters.title: Phantom of the Newborn
characters.description: A pale, translucent young woman standing at the edge of the abyss, weeping softly into her hands.

characters.name: The Orderly
characters.title: Silent Attendant
characters.description: A young clinical orderly standing rigidly at attention beside the examination doors, awaiting Vermin's bell chime with blank obedience.

characters.name: The Clinic Receptionist
characters.title: Intake Clerk
characters.description: A weary receptionist seated behind a glass intake partition, sorting complaints about confusing business signs and missed appointments.
